app.name: AgentWatch
evidence.tip.E3: Reported by the agent itself, not confirmed at the system layer
evidence.tip.S: Sampled; short-lived events may be missing
evidence.tip.I: Inferred by a correlation rule; not a fact
evidence.tip.NA: This field cannot be obtained on the current platform or mode
na.es_no_read_event: macOS provides no per-read events; only the open-for-read is known
na.mmap_not_observable: File was accessed through a memory mapping; byte counts are unavailable
na.tls_no_proxy: TLS without a proxy; URL unavailable
na.direct_bypass_proxy: Process connected directly, bypassing the proxy; URL unavailable
na.cert_pinned: Client rejected the proxy certificate (certificate pinning suspected)
na.quic: QUIC/HTTP3 does not pass through the HTTP proxy; URL unavailable
na.ech: Encrypted ClientHello in use; domain unavailable
na.no_dns_observed: No DNS resolution was observed (DoH or a hardcoded IP possible)
na.preexisting: Already existed before attach; earlier data unavailable
na.collector_unavailable: The current mode cannot collect this (see aw doctor)
na.attribution_break: Performed by a process outside the session; attribution chain broken
na.partial_client_hello: TLS handshake first packet incomplete; domain unavailable
na.h2_hpack: HTTP/2 headers are compressed; full URL unavailable
na.too_large: File or body exceeds the comparison limit
na.file_changed: File changed before comparison; result unusable
na.peer_unknown: The process at the other end of the channel could not be determined
na.protocol_not_observed: mcp-tap or proxy not enabled; method and tool name unavailable
auth.title: Sign-in required
auth.body: Open this page with aw ui. An opening link works once; reloading this tab keeps you signed in, a new tab needs aw ui again.
auth.failed: The link was already used or has expired. Run aw ui again.
auth.serviceDown: The AgentWatch service is not running
auth.serviceDownBody: The window cannot reach the background service on this machine. Start it (aw daemon start), then retry.
auth.forbidden: Not allowed to connect to the AgentWatch service
auth.forbiddenBody: The service is running but does not accept this OS user. Add the user to the agentwatch group (Windows: AgentWatch Users), sign in to the OS again, then retry.
auth.busy: The AgentWatch service is busy. Retry in a moment.
auth.timeout: The AgentWatch service did not answer in time. Retry.
auth.broken: The connection to the AgentWatch service broke: {reason}
auth.daemonError: The service is running but returned an error: {reason}
session.recordingInterruptedReason: The background service restarted; recording was interrupted
session.stopNotice: The program is still running; it is just no longer recorded
density.aria: Time density bar; drag to select a range
density.gap: A collection gap falls in this span
detail.title: Record detail
detail.empty: Select a record to see its fields and evidence
bytes.approx: Partly sampled or covering a gap window: {reason}
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.col.name: Name / command
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete session “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
sessions.compareDisabled: Comparison comes in a later phase
new.title: New session
new.proxyTip: Launch injects HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY, plus NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, SSL_CERT_FILE, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE and GIT_SSL_CAINFO. Older Node.js built-in fetch, Go using the system trust store, and Electron / Chromium may ignore these.
new.noTty: Programs launched from the UI have no interactive terminal; use aw run for interactive agents.
new.procNotCollected: Not collected: the service could not read the process table ({reason}). An empty list here does not mean nothing is running.
new.procNoAgent: No process recognised as an agent. Untick “Agents only” to see every process.
new.procScopeOwn: Only processes of your own account are listed.
new.procReason.noProcessTable: this platform has no process table the service can read
overview.findingsEmpty: No activity matching the rules was found within what was observed
overview.findingsLater: Finding rules arrive in a later phase; this is a placeholder.
timeline.findingLater: Inference and finding evidence are shown in a later phase
procs.snapshot: From a snapshot; time precision is limited by the sampling interval
procs.breakTip: Attribution break: later activity happened outside this session and is not counted
net.basis: Byte basis: bytes_up / bytes_down are transport-layer payload bytes. They include TLS record overhead, HTTP headers and protocol frames, and exclude IP/TCP/UDP headers, retransmits and ACKs. HTTP body bytes exclude headers.
net.httpPlaceholder: Proxy was not enabled for this session
net.httpLater: HTTP request detail arrives in a later phase
net.noPtr: Only domain mappings observed inside the session are shown; no reverse lookup is done
gaps.jump: Show this span in the timeline
settings.title: Settings
settings.purgeCount: {count} finished sessions older than {days} days will be deleted.
settings.purgeNeedsAdmin: "Clean up now" needs administrator rights: it deletes old sessions of every user. Ask an administrator, or open the app as one.
settings.purgeConfirm: Clean up finished sessions under the current retention policy? Pinned sessions are kept.
settings.proxyReadonly: Proxy settings become editable in a later phase
settings.rulesReadonly: Rule toggles become editable in a later phase
settings.forbidden: This identity cannot change this setting
search.title: Search across sessions
search.slow: Substring search is slow: full-text index is off
search.empty.mid: ". Session names and commands are not searched here; use the
search.hint.before: Searches only what was collected in each session (this version collects processes only). To find a session by name or command, search the
findings.group.contentInfo: Request body chunk-matched a file read in this session — the strongest correlation evidence. No match does not mean no upload.
findings.group.factInfo: Directly observed by the kernel or confirmed via the protocol layer (E2).
findings.group.inferredInfo: Derived by a correlation rule, not directly observed. A caveat is always shown.
findings.inferredCaveat: Temporal proximity does not mean file content was sent.
findings.contentMatchCaveat: Encrypted, re-encoded, or hashed content cannot be matched; no match does not mean no transmission.
findings.gapCaveat: A collection gap exists during this window (gap ID: {id}); findings may be incomplete.
findings.empty: No rule-matching activity found within the observed scope
selfReport.title: Self-report
selfReport.lead: Left: what the agent reported (E3). Right: what the system observed (E1 / E2). The two lists are not paired.
selfReport.noE3: This session has no agent self-reports.
selfReport.noObserved: No E1 or E2 rows in the loaded window.
selfReport.httpNa: HTTP details for this session are unavailable (the HTTP list is not connected).
selfReport.unmatchedNa: Matching is not built yet, so no record is marked as matched or unmatched.
compare.title: Compare sessions
compare.lead: Comparison is not built yet. Only basic facts of the two sessions are listed below.
compare.same: The two sides are the same session.
compare.capabilityNote: Collector capabilities differ. A difference, once one can be listed, may come from what each side could observe.
compare.noVerdict: This view does not rank the two sessions.
error.unauthorized: Your sign-in has expired. Open the page again with aw ui.
error.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to do this
error.notImplemented: This feature is not built in this version
error.status: The background service returned an error ({status}) without a reason
error.page.title: This page ran into an error
error.page.body: The page failed while rendering. No data was affected; go back to the session list and open it again.
new.capNotProbed: Unavailable (the service did not report). The forms below still work.
search.noTime: The search result carries no time
timeline.laggedUnknown: The live stream fell behind and dropped records; how many is unknown
timeline.summaryNaAll: These rows have no summary: this version only records process start and exit. Open a row to see its fields.
timeline.beforeSessionTip: This process was already running when the session started; the time is its start time
procs.filterName: Filter by process name or PID
procs.nameNaTip: The executable path could not be read (not enough permission, or the process had exited)
procs.exitNaTip: The exit code was not read (process polling does not see a non-child's exit status)
coverage.notCollectedTip: This version does not collect {kind} (process sampling only)
coverage.notCollected: Not collected: this version does not collect {kind} (process sampling only). No data here does not mean nothing happened.
coverage.unknown: No {kind} records. The service did not say whether {kind} is collected, so this cannot tell "nothing happened" from "not collected".
overview.noRecordedGapsYet: Recording; no collection gaps recorded so far
overview.coverageUnknown: Coverage unavailable; completeness cannot be confirmed
net.chartEmpty: No traffic data, so no chart
disk.unavailable: Disk usage unavailable (not reported by the service)
disk.unavailablePerUser: Disk usage unavailable (not visible to a normal user)
settings.rulesNotListed: The service returned no redaction rule list; built-in rules are unavailable.
settings.collectorsNotListed: The service did not report collector state.
settings.detectRulesNotListed: The service returned no finding rule list; unavailable.
sessions.statInOverview: The session list does not total this; open the session to see it in the overview
gaps.noCollectors: The service returned no collector information for this session.
gaps.capsNotDescribed: This collector did not describe what it captures.
timeline.timeNaTip: This record has no usable time (it was not read at capture)
redact.rule.tok.url_userinfo: User name and password in a URL (scheme://user:pass@)
redact.rule.argv.flag_secret: The value after a password/token flag (e.g. --token xxx)
redact.rule.argv.header: Authorization, Cookie and similar headers passed with -H
redact.rule.argv.env_assign: NAME=value arguments whose name looks secret
redact.rule.env.secret_name: Values of environment variables whose name looks secret; variables outside the allowlist are dropped
redact.rule.url.query_secret: URL query values whose name looks secret
redact.rule.header.blocked: Values of Authorization, Cookie and similar headers; headers outside the allowlist are cleared
error.programNotFound: the program or the working directory was not found. Check the command and the directory.
error.programNotPermitted: Your account cannot access this program or working directory.
error.spawnFailed: the program could not be started. Check the command.
error.randomUnavailable: The system random source is unavailable. Try again shortly.
error.dropFailed: The program did not switch to your account and was stopped.
error.callerUnidentified: Your system account could not be confirmed, so the program was not started.
error.launchOtherUser: The service runs under an ordinary account and can only start programs for that account. Run AgentWatch as a system service, then try again.
error.collectorUnavailable: This version records new sessions on Linux only.
error.noSuchProcess: That process is not running (or its details cannot be read).
error.noDatabase: The service has no writable database, so it cannot record sessions.
error.writeFailed: Could not write the export to the chosen location. Try another location.
error.sessionEnded: This session has ended; nothing more can be attached.
error.dbBusy: The session database is busy (the service is writing). Waited {seconds} s and still couldn't get in; try again later.
new.capReasonNotRunning: no collector for them runs in this mode
